amendments.normalized_body: In VS-07 (nitrate removal), the bare-bottom arm sets `denitrification_vmax_mg_n_per_l_per_hour = 0.2` and `denitrification_pore_water_mixing_factor = 1.0` but has no substrate (`substrate_layers.clear()`). The comment says the substrate removal eliminates the denitrification pathway, so these process params are presumably inert without substrate. However, explicitly zeroing these params on the bare arm (or adding a comment explaining that substrate absence makes them no-ops) would make the test's intent clearer and guard against future model changes that might introduce a water-column denitrification pathway where these params would suddenly matter.

The validation_scenarios.md report template (lines 508-511) still references `maturity=X.XX` in the VS-01 cycling checkpoints, but the scenario's code and envelope bounds no longer validate the biofilter maturity index (the doc note at line 69-72 explicitly says cycling completion is validated by nitrification output, not maturity index). The template should drop the maturity field from the checkpoint lines or add a note that it is reported for observability only, to avoid confusion when the calibration workflow (G4) auto-populates it.

In `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:557-559` and `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:632`, remove the hidden `.max(0.01)` fallback or replace it with explicit zero handling. The new validation path now accepts `temp_condition_min_factor = 0.0`, but molt cadence still silently treats that as `0.01`, so a configuration that is supposed to set the cadence floor to zero will still advance molt readiness and eventually resolve molts instead of freezing readiness.

In `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:1380-1440`, gate `critical_gh_failure` on `params.gh_min_d > 0.0`, matching the new guard added in `molt_cycle`. Right now, when `gh_min_d` is disabled (`0.0`), a failed molt at `GH=0` will still emit a bogus `critical GH ratio` detail even though the success/failure path no longer treats GH as a hard fail in that mode.
